## Motivation

`nightly-test-intel.yml` holds two independent nightlies on two crons under one name, "Nightly Test (Intel)":

- `nightly-xpu-kernel-main-{1,2,4,8}-gpu` (sglang main + sgl-kernel-xpu main, image `latest-kernel-main`) at 19:30 UTC
- `nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu` (pinned sgl-kernel-xpu wheel, image `latest`) at 17:00 UTC

Each run shows the other schedule's jobs as "skipped", and the two can't be told apart in the Actions UI. Split them into two workflows.

## Modifications

- `nightly-test-intel.yml` -> **Nightly Main Test (Intel)**: `nightly-xpu-kernel-main-{1,2,4,8}-gpu` + `check-all-jobs`, cron `30 19 * * *`.
- `nightly-test-intel-wheel.yml` (new) -> **Nightly Wheel Test (Intel)**: `nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu` moved unchanged + its own `check-all-jobs`, cron `0 17 * * *`, own concurrency group (`nightly-test-intel-wheel-...`).
- Both keep the `push` (`python/sglang/version.py`), `workflow_dispatch` and `workflow_call` triggers. The per-job `github.event.schedule != ...` guards are dropped since each file now has a single cron.
- `xpu-ci-job-monitor.yml`: the Actions snapshot, nightly job list (`yq` over both files, `sort -u`), per-job nightly reports, runner fleet report and status dashboard read both files. The per-model 1x/2x/4x/8x report uses kernel-main artifacts only and stays on `nightly-test-intel.yml`; its messages now say "Nightly Main Test (Intel)".
- `release-branch-cut.yml`: add a `run-nightly-tests-intel-wheel` job that calls `nightly-test-intel-wheel.yml` with the release ref, next to the existing `nightly-test-intel.yml` call, so release-branch validation still covers the wheel job after the split.

Both workflows keep `runs-on: intel-bmg-nightly`, served by a single runner, so jobs from the two workflows still run one at a time (as they do today across the two crons); if the wheel run overruns 19:30 UTC the Main jobs queue until it finishes.

The test fixes that were originally in the same PR are in #44100.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A (CI config only). Checked with pre-commit (incl. `check-workflow-job-names`) and actionlint: no new findings vs main other than the existing `cancel-in-progress` expression warning now also reported for the copied line in the new file. The split has not been run on GitHub; `workflow_dispatch` needs the file on the default branch, so the first 17:00 / 19:30 UTC runs after merge will exercise it.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Add a sibling call to this new workflow with the same release ref.

detail.title: [CI] [XPU] nightly: Split Intel Main and Wheel workflows

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,201 @@
+name: Nightly Wheel Test (Intel)
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    # 22:30 IST (UTC+5:30) → 17:00 UTC daily.
+    - cron: '0 17 * * *'
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+    paths:
+      - "python/sglang/version.py"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      continue_on_error:
+        description: 'Continue on error (do not fail the workflow on test failures)'
+        required: false
+        type: boolean
+        default: true
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      ref:
+        description: "Branch, tag or SHA to checkout"
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ""
+      continue_on_error:
+        description: 'Continue on error (do not fail the workflow on test failures)'
+        required: false
+        type: boolean
+        default: true
+
+concurrency:
+  group: nightly-test-intel-wheel-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('manual-{0}', github.run_id) || inputs.ref && format('caller-{0}', github.run_id) || format('{0}-{1}', github.ref, github.event.schedule) }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ !inputs.ref && github.event_name != 'workflow_call' && github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}
+
+jobs:
+  nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu:
+    # sglang main + prebuilt sgl-kernel-xpu wheel: PR CI suites plus nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu.
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    runs-on: intel-bmg-nightly
+    # Two suites back to back (~5h est. incl. setup) exceed the 360-min default.
+    timeout-minutes: 600
+    env:
+      DOCKERHUB_INTEL_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_INTEL_USERNAME }}
+      DOCKERHUB_INTEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_INTEL_TOKEN }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Reset workspace ownership
+        run: |
+          docker run --rm -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/w" busybox:latest \
+            chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /w || true
+
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+
+      - name: Start CI container (pull intel/sglang-dev:latest)
+        run: |
+          export HF_TOKEN="$(cat ~/huggingface_token.txt)"
+          bash scripts/ci/xpu/xpu_ci_start_container.sh --image-tag latest
+        env:
+          GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
+
+      - name: Overlay in-tree sglang test helpers onto image site-packages
+        run: |
+          # Bridges the up-to-24h window between merge and nightly image rebuild.
+          dest=$(docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 -c \
+                 "import sglang, os; print(os.path.dirname(sglang.__file__))")
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu cp \
+            /sglang-checkout/python/sglang/test/ci/ci_utils.py \
+            "$dest/test/ci/ci_utils.py"
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 -c \
+            "import sglang.test.ci.ci_utils; print('overlay ok')"
+
+      - name: HF login + install run_suite extras
+        timeout-minutes: 10
+        run: |
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir tabulate
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --no-deps xgrammar==0.1.33
+          # Pin the image's torch/sglang/kernel builds, and take the diffusion extra's
+          # deps from pyproject_xpu.toml instead of installing sglang[diffusion] from PyPI.
+          docker exec -i ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
+          import importlib.metadata as md
+          import tomllib
+
+          pins = []
+          for name in ("torch", "torchvision", "torchaudio", "sglang", "sglang-kernel-xpu"):
+              try:
+                  pins.append(f"{name}=={md.version(name)}")
+              except md.PackageNotFoundError:
+                  pass
+          with open("/tmp/image-pins.txt", "w") as f:
+              f.write("\n".join(pins) + "\n")
+          with open("/sglang-checkout/python/pyproject_xpu.toml", "rb") as f:
+              deps = tomllib.load(f)["project"]["optional-dependencies"]["diffusion"]
+          with open("/tmp/diffusion-deps.txt", "w") as f:
+              f.write("\n".join(deps) + "\n")
+          print("image pins:", pins)
+          PY
+          PIP_INSTALL="/opt/venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir -c /tmp/image-pins.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu"
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu $PIP_INSTALL "lm-eval==0.4.9"
+          # Test deps of the PR CI suites (mirrors pr-test-xpu.yml, minus the sglang reinstall).
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu $PIP_INSTALL pytest expecttest ray huggingface_hub "lmcache>=0.3.9" accelerate
+          # Diffusion extra's deps (needed by test_xpu_zimage_turbo).
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu $PIP_INSTALL -r /tmp/diffusion-deps.txt
+          # HF /whoami-v2 is aggressively rate-limited and the scheduled
+          # jobs all hit it at the same second. Retry with linear backoff +
+          # jitter to desynchronize them.
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /bin/bash -c '
+            for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
+              /opt/venv/bin/hf auth login --token "${HF_TOKEN}" && exit 0
+              sleep_secs=$((i * 15 + RANDOM % 15))
+              echo "hf auth login failed (attempt $i), retrying in ${sleep_secs}s..."
+              sleep "${sleep_secs}"
+            done
+            exit 1
+          '
+
+      - name: Download olmOCR-bench dataset (for test_deepseek_ocr_2_olmbench)
+        timeout-minutes: 30
+        run: |
+          # PyMuPDF renders the bench PDFs to images; bench_sglang.py errors
+          # every sample without it.
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir pymupdf
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu /bin/bash -c '
+            /opt/venv/bin/hf download --repo-type dataset allenai/olmOCR-bench \
+              --local-dir /sglang-checkout/olmOCR-bench'
+
+      - name: PR CI suites (stage-a + stage-b, 1-GPU XPU)
+        # Same suites and budget as pr-test-xpu.yml.
+        timeout-minutes: 180
+        run: |
+          touch github_summary_ci.md
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu bash -c "
+            source /opt/venv/bin/activate &&
+            cd /sglang-checkout/test &&
+            GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=/sglang-checkout/github_summary_ci.md \
+            SGLANG_IS_IN_CI=true \
+            python3 run_suite.py --hw xpu --suite stage-a-test-1-gpu-xpu,stage-b-test-1-gpu-xpu --timeout-per-file 600 --retry-timeout-increase 0 --enable-retry ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }}
+          " || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
+          echo "$(<github_summary_ci.md)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
+          exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE:-0}
+
+      - name: Kernel-wheel nightly suite (1-GPU XPU)
+        # Run even if the PR CI suites failed; skip only on cancel.
+        if: success() || failure()
+        timeout-minutes: 240
+        run: |
+          touch github_summary.md nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu-metrics.jsonl
+          docker exec ci_sglang_xpu bash -c "
+            source /opt/venv/bin/activate &&
+            cd /sglang-checkout/test &&
+            OLMOCR_BENCH_DIR=/sglang-checkout/olmOCR-bench/bench_data \
+            GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=/sglang-checkout/github_summary.md \
+            SGLANG_IS_IN_CI=true \
+            SGLANG_TEST_METRICS_FILE=/sglang-checkout/nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu-metrics.jsonl \
+            python3 run_suite.py --hw xpu --suite nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu --nightly --timeout-per-file 7200 ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }}
+          " || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
+          echo "$(<github_summary.md)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
+          exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE:-0}
+
+      - name: Upload per-model metrics jsonl
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu-metrics
+          path: nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu-metrics.jsonl
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30
+
+      - name: Cleanup container
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          docker run --rm -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/w" busybox:latest \
+            chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /w || true
+          rm -rf test/result.jsonl test/results test/.pytest_cache .pytest_cache || true
+          find . -type d -name "__pycache__" -prune -exec rm -rf {} + || true
+          find . -type f -name "*.pyc" -delete || true
+          docker rm -f ci_sglang_xpu || true
+          if [[ -n "${CI_SGLANG_XPU_IMAGE:-}" ]]; then
+            docker rmi -f "${CI_SGLANG_XPU_IMAGE}" || true
+          fi
+
+  check-all-jobs:
+    if: always() && (github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
+    needs:
+      - nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Check if any job failed
+        run: |
+          if [[ "${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') }}" == "true" ]]; then
+            echo "One or more nightly test jobs failed"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if [[ "${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}" == "true" ]]; then
+            echo "One or more nightly test jobs were cancelled"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "All nightly test jobs passed"

`release-branch-cut.yml` still calls only nightly-test-intel.yml. Before this split that reusable call ran both main and wheel jobs; afterward it will silently omit wheel validation for a release branch.

Add a sibling call to this new workflow with the same release ref.
